Joshua Wong jailed for 10 more years
Man jailed weeks after bail is freed

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: Drones hit homes and a market
bullets: Eight killed in Um Dibo, West Kordofan, on Monday evening.
A drone hit a fuel station in El Abbasiya Tagali market; at least four dead.
A Blue Nile group blames the RSF; no RSF response was reported.
stories.caption:
A mother of three was among those killed in Ed Damazin, local groups say, as drones also knock out power and water. No RSF response was reported.
Source: Dabanga

stories.label: World · Expression
stories.head: Joshua Wong sentenced again
bullets: Convicted of conspiring to collude with foreign forces under the security law.
In custody since November 2020; he was due for release early next year.
Authorities say the law maintains stability; HRW calls the charges baseless.
stories.caption:
Once the teenage face of Hong Kong's protests, Wong, now 30, could stay in prison until 2036, HRW says. Authorities say the law keeps the city stable.
Source: BBC

stories.label: Manipur
stories.head: Gunfight between Naga groups
bullets: Firing began around 3.30 am in Taodaijang village on Wednesday.
Reports put the dead at three or four; several were injured.
Gunfire kept security forces from reaching the area at first, an official said.
stories.caption:
In Taodaijang, gunfire between rival armed groups went on for hours from 3.30 am. Three of the dead were aged 20 to 25, EastMojo reports.
Source: EastMojo

stories.label: Accountability Watch
stories.head: Freed after bail was ignored
bullets: The court granted the man bail on 28 September; he was still in jail.
Judges called it "very disturbing" and ordered his release.
Uttar Pradesh must say by 3 December why he should not be compensated.
stories.caption:
Bail on paper did not open the cell door for weeks. The court now asks Uttar Pradesh why he should not be paid compensation; no state explanation was reported.
Source: LiveLaw

hope_caption:
This week a Bihar officer who fired on villagers was suspended within a day, and two courts stepped in on lawyers' safety and an ignored bail order.
Source: Indian Express, The Hindu, LiveLaw
